title: Organiser pre-event PDF: A Marathon Oozing Talent (2025 preview, records and 2024 results)
publisher: A.S.O. — Schneider Electric Marathon de Paris
claims: The organiser's preview describes Paris as the fifth-fastest marathon with over 20,000 participants, with an average finishing time of 4:11:23 for the field (referring to the 2024 edition).
The listed course records at the time were Elisha Rotich (KEN) 2:04:21 in 2021 and Judith Jeptum Korir (KEN) 2:19:48 in 2022; the women's mark was broken in 2026.
2024 winners: men Mulugeta Uma (ETH) 2:05:33; women Mestawut Fikir (ETH) 2:20:45; leading French entrants Adrien Toucas (FRA) 2:17:06 and Laurie Maleysson (FRA) 2:46:29.
2024 wheelchair winners: men Geert Schipper (NED) 1:34:36, Julien Casoli (FRA) 1:37:11; women Rita Cuccuru (ITA) 2:35:21.
